tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the sites (one per trade and country) grouped by country, with the trade in English. Pass country to get one country with site names and the local trade word; pass trade to search by trade. Use the site in the other tools.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What the site offers, the questions of its request form (with option ids) for find_providers, and whether requests through an assistant are open. Contact details are entered by the consumer on the town page.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: For a town, returns the town page, whether companies there are connected, their names and prefill_link. Pass answers and a short description to get prefill_link filled in; they are kept briefly on our server behind the link. The consumer checks the details and sends the request on the town page. Nev
